subject.title: feat(cron): serve cron run history from the task ledger

question: Should cron history reads become task-ledger-authoritative before per-source retention and a doctor-owned legacy-history migration are included?
rationale: This staging choice changes shipped retention and upgrade behavior for durable user state; tests cannot decide whether maintainers accept that interim contract.

options.title: Complete the boundary first
options.body: Add per-source retention and a doctor-owned migration that reconciles existing thin mirrors before switching external history reads.

options.title: Narrow this PR
options.body: Keep the additive detail schema and full-fidelity dual-write, but defer the read flip and history import to the follow-up.

options.title: Accept the staged upgrade risk
options.body: Merge the current read flip while explicitly accepting shorter history, duplicate legacy task rows, and startup-time migration exposure until the follow-up lands.

recommendation.title: Complete the boundary first
recommendation.body: Add per-source retention and a doctor-owned migration that reconciles existing thin mirrors before switching external history reads.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked issue and recent cron/state history place the migration staging decision closest to this owner.
